payload.title: signify's exclusion law omits outside the core
payload.body: Beside oracle-scope's assay: signify's exclusion law (a concept outside dom(α) gets no anchor) lists two reasons for a concept falling outside dom(α). Now that dom(α) is the core agent dimension names and values, a concept outside the core falls outside it for a third reason the law does not list. Wording only; for a following plan.
